# Moon 0.4.14 beta
Your spaces, within easy reach.
- Rename or delete a space from its sidebar name or page dot. No need to switch to horizontal tabs. - Hover a space and press Option–Command–Delete to request deletion. - The confirmation identifies the target space. Default browsing is protected, and shared website sign-ins, history and bookmarks are preserved. - Keep left-swipe creation, right-swipe return, and the minimal page dots. A single default browsing space shows no label or dots.
Apple silicon, macOS 26 or later. One signed DMG serves installation and in-app updates. This Moon beta is Apple Development signed and is not Apple-notarized.
